newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cultus to raise A$13 million by issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cultus to raise A$13 million by issue.

text.p: Oil explorer Cultus Petroleum NL said on Thursday it would raise more than A$13 million by the issue of 16.5 million fully paid shares to new and existing institutional investors at 80 cents each.

The company said the funds would primarily be used to fund the appraisal work now being conducted on the onshore Otway Basin in South Australia, particularly around the Skull Creek One discovery well. The remaining funds would be used to retire some debt.
Cultus shares were four cents higher at 89 cents at 1.40 p.m. (0340 GMT). -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
